core/ai/focus_extract.py - targeted, single-call extraction of a SMALL set
of fields the cached regex recipe left blank.

This is the "AI 自愈" second call. The first (cached) parse was zero-AI, but if a
header / entity field is empty while its human-readable label is clearly in the
document, we ask the model ONCE for just those fields instead of re-reading the
whole PO. Reuses the same transport (_chat_online / chat_local) and the same
thinking-off / input-compression levers as the full read, so it is cheap and
fast. When no AI is configured (offline, or local model missing) it returns {}
immediately - the caller then leaves the value blank, exactly as before.

You are a purchase-order field FILLER. The document was
already parsed by a rule engine, but a few specific fields came back blank. Your
job is to read ONLY the document text below and return those fields. Do NOT
re-list order lines or totals. Output ONE compact JSON object, no prose, no
markdown outside the JSON.

Schema:
{
  "header": {
    "customer": "", "season": "", "currency": "", "price_term": "", "payment_terms": "",
    "port_loading": "", "port_discharge": "", "ship_mode": "",
    "vendor_name": "", "agent_name": "", "product_desc": "", "style_no": "",
    "import_po_no": "", "reference_no": "", "cir_no": "",
    "freight_terms": "", "country_of_origin": "", "dc_address": ""
  },
  "orders": [
    {"po_no": "", "delivery_date": "YYYY-MM-DD"}
  ]
}

Rules:
1. Only fill a field if you can SEE it in the document text. Use "" otherwise.
   NEVER invent a value.
2. For delivery_date, report it per order (po_no). If the whole document shares
   one shipment / delivery date, repeat it under every po_no you can identify.
3. European number format: a DOT is thousands, a COMMA is decimal. Only relevant
   if a field carries a number.
4. Season / style / vendor strings: copy exactly as printed.
5. Output valid JSON only.

True only when a usable engine is configured, so we never attempt a
    pointless network / model call on an offline workstation.

Ask the model for only ``fields`` (a subset of the FOCUS schema keys).

    Returns {"header": {key: value}, "orders": [{po_no, delivery_date}]}. Never
    raises: on any failure (offline, bad JSON, timeout) it returns {} so the
    caller simply leaves the field blank.
